title: Evidence pipeline and remediation sprint plan for compliance controls
creator: Aisha Bhatia
description: Create an end-to-end evidence collection pipeline and a timeboxed remediation sprint plan to reduce open compliance gaps across SOC2, ISO27001, and SSO/audit-log requirements. Deliverables: automated evidence extraction templates, owner assignments, sprint backlog for tech debt remediation, and a dashboard showing evidence coverage by control.
milestones: Milestone 1: Control mapping complete and owners assigned (SOC2+ISO crosswalk) - 2025-02-28
Milestone 2: Evidence catalog and extraction templates ready (Confluence + scripts) - 2025-03-07
Milestone 3: First remediation sprint (2 weeks) targeting P0/P1 controls - 2025-03-21
Milestone 4: Evidence automation hooked to audit-log pipeline and SSO logs - 2025-04-04
Milestone 5: Final evidence review and submission package for auditors - 2025-04-15
tasks: Map SOC2 and ISO controls to existing Redwood policies and infra components
Inventory current evidence sources (S3, Datadog, Postgres audit tables, identity provider logs)
Create evidence extraction templates for each control (scriptable steps + expected artifacts)
Implement retention + encryption verification for audit logs (SSE-KMS proof)
Automate periodic snapshot of evidence into a read-only evidence bucket with checksum
Define service-level acceptance criteria for each control (logged events, retention, alerting)
Run first remediation sprint: fix 6 auth-event gaps, reduce expired certs, and close 3 doc gaps
Build a lightweight dashboard showing percent evidence coverage and outstanding TODOs
Prepare auditor-facing package and walkthrough notes
stakeholders: Engineering Leads: Priya Raman, Kai Sullivan
acceptance_criteria: All P0 controls have evidence artifacts and owner sign-off
Automated evidence extraction runs on schedule and stores checksummed artifacts
Retention and encryption for audit logs verified with test artifacts
Dashboard shows >= 85% coverage for scope items defined in project
risks: Incomplete log instrumentation in legacy services leading to missing evidence
Owners unavailable during remediation sprint due to on-call rotations
Automation scripts require elevated access; approval process may delay rollout
False positives in evidence validator creating extra triage work
notes: Triage decisions: prefer automated evidence generation over manual screenshots where possible
We will split the remediation sprint into infra remediation and doc/evidence curation lanes
Consolidated evidence will be stored in a read-only, immutable S3 prefix with lifecycle rules
Plan to run a dry-run auditor review internally on 2025-04-08
